Dirt paths never revert to dirt when the block above becomes solid, and never revert on schedule. Vanilla 26.1.1 DirtPathBlock is byte-identical to 26.1's. items.evidence: Vanilla 26.1.1 HAS bonemeal height gates (unlike 1.21.7), re-verified fresh by javap: SaplingBlock.isValidBonemealTarget = ServerLevel AND isInsideBuildHeight(pos.above(getMinimumHeight)); AzaleaBlock = same + 2 and fluid above empty; MushroomBlock = feature exists AND AbstractHugeMushroomFeature AND HugeMushroomFeatureConfiguration AND isInsideBuildHeight(pos.above(4 + foliageRadius)). The port's bonemeal_valid (bonemeal.rs:326-360) matches in form, but tree_minimum_height (growth.rs:446-453) reads json["trunk_placer"]["base_height"] at the JSON top level, while the stored feature JSON nests it under config — configured_json (worldgen/live.rs:234) returns the raw whole feature JSON. So it always returns 0 (vanilla base heights: oak 4, spruce 5, mangrove 2, azalea 4, birch 5, jungle 4, acacia 5, cherry 7, dark/pale oak 6). Same nesting bug for mushrooms: the port reads json["foliage_radius"] top-level (bonemeal.rs:353) but it lives under config (brown = 3, red = 2); the port always uses 2 — red correct by luck, brown's gate is pos.y+6 instead of pos.y+7. isBonemealSuccess (sapling/azalea 0.45, mushroom/fungus 0.4) matches vanilla exactly. Fix note: read config.trunk_placer.base_height and config.foliage_radius (or make configured_json return the config object). The opposite direction (too strict) is the NEW item B5-G29 — both directions are live at once in 26.1.1.
items.title: Bonemeal validity too permissive at the build ceiling: sapling/azalea/mushroom height gates read the wrong JSON level (REPRODUCES from 26.1)

items.evidence: Vanilla passes the SoundSource as a parameter at each play site: Shearable.shear(level, source, stack) takes BLOCKS from the dispenser (tryShearEntity) and PLAYERS from player shearing; LevelEventHandler case 3003 plays the wax-on sound on BLOCKS. The port's Audio::play (audio.rs:1828 -> play_seeded :1978) derives the source from the event name via settings::sound_source (settings.rs:18-90, a prefix heuristic) — it can never express a source that depends on the caller. Verified instances: dispenser shear sounds play on NEUTRAL (sheep, mooshroom, snow golem, copper golem) or HOSTILE (bogged — in the heuristic's HOSTILE list) instead of BLOCKS; the wax-on sound plays on PLAYER (item. prefix) instead of BLOCKS. The heuristic happens to match where the name's prefix matches the context (potion break -> NEUTRAL, digging hit -> BLOCKS, beehive shear -> BLOCKS). Audio::play_on (audio.rs:2026) exists but is used only by /playsound. settings::sound_source is byte-identical between the 26.1 and 26.1.1 trees and the dispenser shear play calls are identical too — shared with 26.1, not a 26.1.1 regression. Audibility caveat: inaudible at default volumes (all sliders 1.0); bites when the user adjusts a category volume. NEW item (missed by the 26.1 run).
